configs.list.title: List configuration entries
configs.list.description: List configuration entries page by page: platform principals see platform entries, tenant principals see platform entries plus their own; encrypted values are never returned.
configs.get.title: Get configuration entry
configs.get.description: Get a configuration entry (encrypted values are never returned).
configs.create.title: Create configuration entry
configs.create.description: Create a configuration entry on the caller’s side: the key is unique per side and the value is checked against the data type; a tenant entry with a platform key overrides it (rejected when the platform entry forbids overrides).
configs.update.title: Update configuration entry
configs.update.description: Update a configuration entry on the caller’s side: name, group, value, default, data type, encryption, order, description and status (the key cannot change; an encrypted entry keeps its value when none is given).
configs.delete.title: Delete configuration entries
configs.delete.description: Delete configuration entries on the caller’s side in bulk; built-in entries are rejected one by one.
dicts.list.title: List dictionaries
dicts.list.description: List dictionaries page by page: platform dictionaries plus the caller’s tenant dictionaries.
dicts.get.title: Get dictionary
dicts.create.title: Create dictionary
dicts.create.description: Create a dictionary on the caller’s side; codes are unique across platform and tenants (dictionaries are never overridden).
dicts.update.title: Update dictionary
dicts.update.description: Update a dictionary on the caller’s side: name, category, description, order and status (the code cannot change).
dicts.delete.title: Delete dictionaries
dicts.delete.description: Delete dictionaries on the caller’s side in bulk; built-in dictionaries and those that still have items are rejected one by one.
dicts.options.title: Get dictionary options
dicts.options.description: Get the options of a dictionary by code: tree dictionaries are flattened depth-first, disabled items are flagged, a disabled dictionary has no options.
dict_items.list.title: List dictionary items
dict_items.list.description: List all items of a dictionary (depth-first, with depth).
dict_items.get.title: Get dictionary item
dict_items.create.title: Create dictionary item
dict_items.create.description: Create an item in an enabled dictionary on the caller’s side: the code is unique in the dictionary, the parent must be in the same dictionary, making it the default clears the other default.
dict_items.update.title: Update dictionary item
dict_items.update.description: Update a dictionary item: parent, name, value, description, metadata, default, order and status (the code cannot change; an item cannot move under itself or its descendants).
dict_items.delete.title: Delete dictionary items
dict_items.delete.description: Delete dictionary items in bulk; items that still have children are rejected one by one.
numbering_rules.list.title: List numbering rules
numbering_rules.list.description: List numbering rules page by page: platform principals see platform rules, tenant principals see their own rules plus platform rules shared with tenants.
numbering_rules.get.title: Get numbering rule
numbering_rules.get.description: Get a numbering rule, including its current period and last issued sequence value.
numbering_rules.create.title: Create numbering rule
numbering_rules.create.description: Create a numbering rule on the caller’s side: the date format must distinguish the reset cycle and the time zone is an IANA id.
numbering_rules.update.title: Update numbering rule
numbering_rules.update.description: Update a numbering rule on the caller’s side; once it has issued numbers the format is frozen and only name, description, order, status and tenant sharing can change.
numbering_rules.delete.title: Delete numbering rules
numbering_rules.delete.description: Delete numbering rules on the caller’s side in bulk; rules that have issued numbers are rejected one by one.
numbering_rules.reset.title: Reset sequence
numbering_rules.reset.description: Safely reset the sequence: the next value must exceed the highest value already issued in the current period (jumping forward is allowed), a reason is required and platform rules need the rule code typed back as confirmation.
numbering_rules.preview.title: Preview number format
numbering_rules.preview.description: Preview numbers for a given format (pure computation, nothing is issued, up to 50).
numbering_rules.generate.title: Issue numbers
numbering_rules.generate.description: Issue numbers from a rule: committed in its own transaction, numbers are consumed permanently; the same idempotency key replays with identical parameters and conflicts otherwise.
numbering_rules.allocations.title: List issue records
numbering_rules.allocations.description: List a rule’s issue records page by page (a tenant only sees the ones it requested).
